claims.content: Enable system operator to initiate or update emergency point reports with current data

goal.raw_text: Enable system operator to initiate or update emergency point reports with current data

claims.content: System Operator
The System Operator has additional or more current information on a previously reported emergency point.
The JU initiating the report must have R² (reporting responsibility) authority for the emergency point, or be assuming it via operator action after inactivity of prior reporter.
A previously reported emergency point must exist with an associated TN Reference and TN value that the new reporting JU shall reuse.
Any JU may report, through operator action only, on a previously reported emergency point when that JU has additional or more current information on the point.

trigger.raw_text: Any JU may report, through operator action only, on a previously reported emergency point when that JU has additional or more current information on the point.

claims.content: The System Operator initiates a report on a previously reported emergency point through manual operator action only.
If the JU has additional or more current information on the emergency point, it reports that updated data.
If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received for the emergency point, or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, the prior unit with R² is declared inactive.
Another JU may assume R² for the emergency point via operator action only after the prior unit is declared inactive.
The JU assuming R² shall use the same TN Reference and the same value of TN Previously Reported as those reported by the previous reporting unit.
Upon successful reporting, the latest JU to report the point holds R² for that point.

If a JU without R² desires that a specific point, line, or area be transmitted immediately without awaiting the next periodic update, it should transmit a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request for the desired TN.
The latest JU to report the point has R² (reporting responsibility) for that point.
The TN Reference and the value of TN Previously Reported used in the report are the same as those reported by the previous reporting unit.
